notes: WArmy 0.4.40 — feat: speech engine selection + UI fixes + agent tooling. Speech & text conversion card renamed and reworked: the enable checkbox is replaced by two dropdowns — speech-to-text (Whisper / sherpa-onnx / follow listening model) and text-to-speech (sherpa-onnx / follow speaking model). Whisper and sherpa-onnx show install-first when not installed; defaults follow the listening/speaking models since local engines are not installed by default. Whisper (MIT, whisper.cpp subprocess) does speech-to-text only; text-to-speech stays sherpa-onnx (Apache-2.0) or the speaking model. Backend ASR/TTS routing honors the selection and falls back to cloud when a local engine is absent. Fixed the Thinking & Execution box width: constant whether expanded or collapsed, equal to the reply bubble; all bubbles (user/workhorse/other) share one width; the side facing the other avatar leaves two avatar widths. New agent tooling: neuro-symbolic prediction constraint gate (ETA/difficulty/subagent/Diwen), hard-gate appeal review, memory-graph enhanced recall, skill semver update detection, evolution A/B experiment analysis, VM snapshot/clone, mimic emotion feedback, local .ics calendar tools, parallel read-only tool calls, Docling/Tree-sitter subprocess parsers (honest gating), smart-voice perception self-improvement + prediction file, anti-sycophancy self-modification gate. MCP bridge plugin restored and bundled. Tool operation records fully localized. Carries all prior features unchanged.
